==Summary==

:{{pov|[[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]]}}
[[Cadsuane]] is in the sun room of the [[Sun Palace]], in [[Cairhien]]. [[Harine din Togara Two Winds]] and her [[Sailmistress]], [[Derah din Selaan Rising Wave]], are in her audience. Harine is demanding the return of her sister, [[Shalon]]. Cadsuane replies that she will be needed for questioning one more day. She is very annoyed with the [[Atha'an Miere]], and also Lord [[Dobraine]] for griping about the bargain [[Rafela]] and [[Merana]] made with them. [[Daigian]] is present in a corner with [[Eben]] who she recently bonded. The five [[Aes Sedai]], [[Elza]], [[Sarene]], [[Nesune]], [[Erian]], and [[Beldeine]] appear nonchalant as they pretend to entertain themselves playing games. Cadsuane is methodically trying to figure out why they swore fealty to [[Rand]], especially the [[Red Ajah|Red]] sisters. {{ref|The sisters swearing to Rand may be a result of the subtle compulsion Verin used on them in the Aiel camp}}

Suddenly, [[Verin]] and [[Sorilea]] enter the room. Cadsuane notices Verin is wearing a flowery brooch. {{ref|Verin's flowery brooch is actually an ''[[angreal]]''}} The aged [[Wise One]] gives the [[Brown Ajah|Brown]] a small vial containing a potion that will make the drinker sleep{{ref|This suggest that Verin planned her end already at this time.}}. Too much, and the drinker will be placed in an eternal slumber. Cadsuane commands Sarene to take the [[Sea Folk]] back to their rooms. Sorilea tells Cadsuane that the last of the nineteen prisoners swore fealty to Rand last night. Cadsuane thinks of the time that she failed to root out the [[Black Ajah]]. Another failure was learning what [[Moiraine]] was doing in [[Chachin]] too late. {{Ref/book|NS|17}} [[Corele]] enters after a while and tells her that [[Damer Flinn]] [[Heal]]ed one of the stilled Aes Sedai, [[Irgain]]. She is back to normal. {{ref|Why is Irgain back to normal when [[Siuan]] and [[Leane]] are not as strong as they used to be? Because you must be Healed by a person of the opposite gender to regain your full strength}} He wants to try to Heal the other sisters who were stilled by Rand: [[Sashalle]] and [[Ronaille]]. Irgain is also happily ready to swear fealty to Rand. Cadsuane had begun gathering sisters she could trust after noticing the strange events occurring in [[Shienar]]. She has had [[Eyes-and-ears]] watching [[Siuan]] and [[Moiraine]] for years, and they have not learned anything useful.

[[Jahar]] runs in and proclaims that [[Alanna]] has collapsed, unconscious. While Cadsuane and her retinue follow Jahar back to Alanna, [[Dobraine Taborwin|Lord Dobraine]] intercepts Cadsuane to tell her [[Caraline Damodred|Lady Caraline]] and [[Darlin Sisnera|Lord Darlin]] have disappeared from [[Arilyn Dhulaine|Lady Arilyn]]'s palace. She dismisses him for now and they continue to Alanna's rooms, and try to Heal her, but nothing happens. Verin appears terrified. {{ref|Why is Verin so afraid that Alanna is unconscious? This is because she thinks something has happened to Rand. It is actually something related to the bonding of Rand by Elayne, Aviendha and Min but it isn't clear why}} Cadsuane knows there is nothing they can do, but wait.

:{{pov|[[Demandred]]}}
[[Demandred]] is frustrated that [[Moridin]] hasn't shown up yet. He is with [[Graendal]], [[Osan'gar]], and [[Aran'gar]]. He knows it is difficult for [[Semirhage]] to attend the meetings, but [[Mesaana]] should have shown up. He has an alliance with both of them, that they will only turn on one another when the others have been eliminated. He is also furious that [[Rand]] has been popping up in several villages since the failed attack on him in [[Cairhien]]. Aran'gar retorts by saying he and Osan'gar were responsible for watching him. She says that she has put her own "charge" fully under control. {{ref|Aran'gar's "charge" is [[Egwene]]}} She also comments that those who [[channel]] ''[[saidin]]'' should be worried, as if Rand removes the "shadow" the Great Lord placed on ''[[saidin]]'', the Great Lord would begin to distrust those who channeled that half of the [[One Power]]. Demandred notes that she is wearing a simple golden ring. He is confused, as "simple" never really fit Graendal. {{ref|Graendal's simple ring is a relatively strong ''angreal''}} Moridin walks in and says that the Great Lord still trusts the male Chosen. Now that the [[Dark One]] has appointed him [[Nae'blis]], only he can access the [[True Power]]. [[Cyndane]], who is trotting complacently behind him, says that Rand has two of the access key ''[[ter'angreal]]'' which will allow him to use the [[Choedan Kal]]. Everyone is very worried. Demandred thought Cyndane was [[Lanfear]], but then Mesaana told him she is weaker than Lanfear was. Moridin says that they will know Rand's exact location when he touches the Choedan Kal. His orders are to find him and capture him, or even kill him if necessary.
